author: The School of Life
description:
We are constantly told to celebrate the endless options modern technology gives us in our search for love. We swipe through thousands of profiles, believing that the perfect match is just a few dates away. 
Start your free Membership trial – 2,000+ articles, 1,000+ videos, 50+ courses, free for a week: https://www.theschooloflife.com/membership 
Yet true psychological maturity begins when we realize we don't actually have that many options at all. Anyone we choose will ultimately offer their own version of human folly, childhood baggage, and communication struggles. In this film, we explore why dating widely only reveals fresh varieties of complexity—and why commitment means choosing which set of problems you're willing to work on.
